title: Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) Replacement and Return Logistics
summary: Protocols for RMA replacement of defective routers/ONTs, dispatch turnaround times, and equipment return compliance.

sections.heading: Hardware Defect Classification
sections.text: RMA replacement is authorized if the NexusHub router exhibits: repetitive hardware boot loop, dead LAN ports post-surge, internal PSU failure, or persistent 5GHz Wi-Fi radio dropouts unrepaired by firmware 4.2.1 flash.

sections.heading: Courier Dispatch & Tracking
sections.text: Standard replacement routers are dispatched via Next-Day Priority Courier with tracked delivery. Customers receive an SMS with live 1-hour delivery tracking window. Cloud settings auto-sync upon plug-in.

sections.heading: Return Packaging and Non-Return Surcharge
sections.text: The replacement package contains a pre-addressed return poly-mailer and prepaid label. The defective hardware must be returned within 21 days of receiving the new unit. An unreturned equipment fee of $120.00 is assessed if not scanned by postal carrier.
